facts.claim: In 2026 the market began pricing Bitcoin miners on their power positions rather than their hashrate: Morgan Stanley research covered in July 2026 framed miners as owners of 'powered shell' assets whose grid connections, land, and development pipelines can support long-term AI leases, and CleanSpark said in January 2026 it was assembling more than 890 MW of aggregate potential utility capacity in Texas for AI and high-performance computing workloads.

sources.excerpt: Power has become the biggest bottleneck for AI infrastructure, making existing bitcoin mining sites attractive candidates for conversion; Morgan Stanley expects owners of 'powered shell' assets to command attractive lease economics as AI companies seek faster access to electricity.
sources.title: Morgan Stanley sees AI data center pivot unlocking upside for bitcoin miners

sources.excerpt: Morgan Stanley initiated coverage on Hut 8, Riot Platforms and Applied Digital on the thesis that owners of 'powered shell' assets can command attractive lease economics as AI companies seek faster access to electricity.

sources.excerpt: More than 890 megawatts of aggregate potential utility capacity across both Houston-area sites, supporting large-scale, next-generation data center campuses designed for artificial intelligence and high-performance computing workloads.
sources.title: CleanSpark Expands Texas Footprint with Major Power Acquisition Near Houston to Support Scaled AI and HPC Development
